optional.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
optional.purpose: Production analytics reports and deployment only; local development does not require provider sign-in.

optional.name: CLOUDFLARE_ANALYTICS_READ_TOKEN
optional.purpose: Production analytics reports only; supply through the workflow secret rather than local bootstrap.

optional.name: PUBLIC_LVBT_ANALYTICS_COLLECTOR
optional.purpose: Override the collector origin for browser acceptance or a reviewed isolated staging collector.

optional.name: LVBT_PREVIEW_URL
optional.purpose: Reviewed HTTPS origin for an isolated collector preview behind Cloudflare Access; required for staging, not ordinary local checks.

optional.name: LVBT_PREVIEW_BINDINGS
optional.purpose: Public JSON descriptor for an isolated EVENTS dataset, distinct EVENT_LIMITER namespace, and secret declaration; required for saved staging artifacts.

optional.name: CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID
optional.purpose: Explicit zone identifier for production readiness only; find the existing lasvegasfortransit.org zone ID in Cloudflare, without changing DNS or provider resources.
